headword: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}
gloss: limited express train; special express train

definitions.gloss: limited express train; special express train
definitions.explanation: A high-speed train service that stops at only a few major stations, offering faster travel than regular express trains. A surcharge is usually required in addition to the base fare.

examples.japanese: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: To head to Osaka by limited express train.

examples.japanese: {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need a limited express ticket to ride the limited express train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}なら⟦{一時間半|いちじかんはん}→一時間半：16688_ichijikanhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: It takes three hours by local train, but you can get there in an hour and a half by limited express.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (limited express; abbreviation of {特別急行|とくべつきゅうこう}) and ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (train). In the Japanese railway hierarchy, ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ is faster than ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ (express) and ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧ (rapid), stopping at fewer stations. Most private railways and JR lines operate ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ services with reserved seating and a supplemental fare ({特急料金|とっきゅうりょうきん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a limited express
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved seat on a limited express
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: limited express timetable
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: the limited express is delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}→急行列車：25988_kyuukouressha⟧: express train — stops at more stations than a limited express; slower
- ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧: bullet train — the fastest category, running on dedicated high-speed tracks
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid train — faster than local but slower than express; usually no surcharge
